Log in

Members

To use all of the facilities you need to log in to the system using the number on your Durham County Council library ticket and your surname. Please enter your ticket number and surname, then click "Log in".

 
 
Important note for members: Once you have logged in, the system will let you request items and renew items. After using the system, please ensure that you log off, particularly if you are using the system in a public place (such as a library). Subsequent screens have a "Log off" option to allow you to do this.

Guests

If you aren't a member of the library, you can still enter as a guest,  but some features will not be available.

You can join the library online or by visiting any of the branches.
